review:
Rise of Ymir is a 5x4 Norse payline slot about the frost giant whose body became the world. Ymir symbols are sticky wild multipliers. Each one locks in place with a value of 1x to 100x and awards a free respin once the wins are paid.

If four Ymirs stick on the same reel, they merge into a Giant Ymir that adds up all four multipliers and applies the total to the whole reel. In the bonuses, newly landed Ymirs also feed a Megamultiplier. The game opens with an atmospheric poem about giants and gods, and the 15,000x maximum is reachable in every mode.
